build_nfnet_model: build an NFNet model with a specified variant like F0 for image classification without normalization layers
run_nfnet_forward_pass: run a forward pass through the NFNet model to get logits and pool outputs for classification
build_nfnet_block: build an NFBlock residual block with squeeze-and-excite, stochastic depth, and grouped depthwise convolutions
count_nfnet_flops: count the FLOPs of an NFNet model given input height and width dimensions
count_nfblock_flops: count the FLOPs of a single NFBlock given its input height and width dimensions
